description: Read-only inspection of a select-like control. Custom controls are opened only as needed, explored within a bounded budget, then restored to their original open, selection, and scroll state. query filters discovered options locally; it never types into the control or triggers remote search.

id.description: Preferred canonical select control ID from DOM.getAXTree.

selector.description: CSS selector for a select-like control. It must resolve to one control; narrow broad selectors when the page contains multiple controls.

pageId.description: Page ID containing the select-like control.

query.description: Case-insensitive filter over options already discovered by this inspection; it does not enter search text or load server-side results.

maxOptions.description: Maximum number of discovered options to return. If the result is truncated or diagnostics.incomplete is true, the returned options are only a partial view.

includeDisabled.description: Include disabled options when true; disabled options cannot be selected.

timeout.description: Maximum temporary exploration time in seconds. Omit or pass 0 to use 300 seconds.

purpose.description: Describe which control choices must be understood, such as enumerating options, checking whether search is exposed, exploring virtual scrolling, or inspecting a cascading picker. query only filters options discovered by this read-only inspection. A successful response includes resolvedControlId for later Input.select calls.
